candidates.sourceText:
HEAVY:
A figure with this Tag may reduce movement from Currents, Effects,
and Abilities by 1. Meaning that Free Movement granted by your own
Disciplines will only be affected by HEAVY if you want them to be.
However, Adventurers with HEAVY must incur a -1 to their total
Movement Value and take a -1 penalty to their Agility. This Tag is
cumulative and can have its effect occur from more than 1 source. This
means that an Adventurer with HEAVY on 2 different Items must incur a -2
to their
Movement Value.

candidates.sourceText:
IMMUNITY : (TYPE):
Figures may have Immunities to Effects or Damage Types. If a figure is
Immune to an Effect, they may not Gain that Effect. If they have the Effect
and then Gain Immunity, they immediately lose the Effect. If a figure is
Immune to Damage, When Calculating Final Damage from an Attack or
SPELL reduce the Final Damage dealt to 0.
candidates.proposalText:
IMMUNITY (TYPE):
Miniaturas podem ter Imunidades a Efeitos ou Tipos de Dano. Se uma miniatura for Imune a um Efeito, não poderá obter esse Efeito. Se tiver o Efeito e, em seguida, obtiver Imunidade, perderá esse Efeito imediatamente. Se uma miniatura for Imune a Dano, ao calcular o Dano Final de um Ataque ou FEITIÇO, reduza a 0 o Dano Final causado.

candidates.sourceText:
LEAP (X):
A figure using this Ability moves up to X spaces orthogonally in a straight
line. A figure using LEAP only provokes Break Attacks from opponents that
were adjacent to them at the start of the movement granted by this Ability.
Figures using the movement from LEAP will ignore other figures and all
Terrain except Obstructing Terrain.
A figure using LEAP may move into spaces that contain other figures of
their base size or smaller as determined by the amount of spaces their base
occupies. If they do, DISPLACE any figures occupying that space. Figures
Displaced this way are dealt a PURPLE
of IRREDUCIBLE DMG.
candidates.proposalText:
LEAP (X):
A miniatura move-se até X espaços em linha reta, na horizontal ou na vertical. Uma miniatura que use LEAP só provoca Ataques de Oportunidade de oponentes que estivessem adjacentes a ela no início do movimento concedido por esta Habilidade. Durante esse movimento, ignora outras miniaturas e todo Terreno, exceto Terreno Obstruído. Pode mover-se para espaços ocupados por miniaturas cuja base ocupe o mesmo número de espaços que a sua ou menos. Se o fizer, DESLOQUE todas as miniaturas que ocuparem esse espaço. As miniaturas Deslocadas assim sofrem um dado ROXO ￼ de DANO IRREDUTÍVEL.
